subject: Dampe
text: Stepping forward in the cave causes Dampe's ghost to challenge Link to a race and start without notice.

evidence.quote:
Step forward a few feet to find the ghost of Dampe.  He will challenge you to a
race, and will start without notice.

subject: Dampe's Race Route
text: To navigate the race, run forward dodging flames, turn right at the hall end, turn left at the next corner, run along the left side between two flames, turn left and immediate right, turn right, left, and left tight, take another tight turn and enter the door; then turn right, right, wide left, enter the wide room, go through the right door, turn left, wide right, through another door, run to the wall, turn right, tight left, jump to the ledge on the left, take a wide left, and tight left into the room with a large pit.

evidence.quote:
Turn right at the halls end, taking the corner tight to dodge a flame.
Turn left at the next corner, taking the turn wide to dodge another flame....Run forward between the pair of flames, running along the left side of the gap.
Turn left and then right immediately on the other side, taking the turn wide to
dodge another flame.  Turn right, then left, then left again, taking the turn
tight.  Take another tight turn on the other side, and go through the door....Take a right on the other side, and another right, and then a wide left.  Run
along the left or right side of the tunnel, then enter the wide room.  Go
through the door on the right.  Take a left, then a wide right, then through
another door.  Run to the wall on the other side, then a right, then a tight
left....Jump onto the ledge to your left, and hug the left wall as you run forward to
dodge more flames.  Take a wide left, then a tight left to enter a tall room
with a large pit in the middle.  Run along the path around the perimeter of the
room and through the door at the top.

subject: Dampe
text: Speaking with Dampe in the room at the top of the race path rewards Link with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Speak with Dampe in this room, and he will give you the Hookshot.

subject: Song of Time Blocks
text: Playing the Song of Time makes the two blue blocks disappear, allowing Link to climb the staircase back into the Windmill.

evidence.quote:
Play the Song of Time to make them disappear, then climb up
the staircase on the other side to find yourself back in the Windmill.

subject: Windmill Staircase
text: If not collected as Young Link, a Piece of Heart is located at the top of the Windmill staircase.

evidence.quote:
If you didn't get the Piece of Heart from the Windmill as Young Link, then
you'll get it now at the top of the staircase.

subject: Organ Grinder
text: Standing in front of the Organ Grinder in the Windmill and taking out the Ocarina teaches Link the Song of Storms.

evidence.quote:
Drop down onto the main floor,
and then stand in front of the Organ Grinder in the Windmill.  Take out your
Ocarina of Time, and he'll teach you the Song of Storms.

subject: Man on the Blue Roof
text: Using the Hookshot from the fence outside the Windmill to latch onto the blue roof allows Link to speak to the man gazing at Death Mountain for a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Jump onto the fence in front of the Windmill door, and look to the right to see
a tall building with a blue roof.  Use the Hookshot to latch onto the blue roof
(you should see a red targeting reticule on the roof)....Once you are on
the roof, speak with the man gazing up at Death Mountain to get another Piece
of Heart.

subject: Impa's House
text: At night, Hookshotting onto the roof of the House of Skulltula and then onto the roof of Impa's House leads to a Gold Skulltula on the southern wall.

evidence.quote:
Play the Sun's Song to make it nighttime....Climb up to the
entrance to Impa's House (the large house at the southern edge of town), and
use the Hookshot to get onto the roof of House of Skulltula.  Once there, use
the Hookshot again to reach the roof of Impa's House.  Head to the southern
wall of Impa's House, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.  Take it's
token.

subject: Ganon's Castle Stone Archway
text: At nighttime, a Gold Skulltula is suspended over the lava on the right side of the stone archway outside Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Make sure it's nighttime, then head forward and around the corner.  Run under
the stone archway, and turn around on the other side.  On the right side of the
archway, suspended over the lava, there is a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take
it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Kokiri Twin's House
text: At nighttime, a Gold Skulltula is located on the back of the tree of the Kokiri Twin's house, on the south side of the pond.

evidence.quote:
Change it to nighttime if you need to, then head for the east side of
the forest to the Kokiri Twin's house.  It's the house on the south side of the
pond with the twin branches coming out of it's top.  Kill the Gold Skulltula on
the back of the tree and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Magic Leaf Behind Shop
text: Riding the Magic Leaf planted behind the Shop carries Link around Kokiri Forest to a hidden alcove containing Rupees.

evidence.quote:
If you planted the Magic Bean behind the Shop as Young Link, then you can now
ride the Magic Leaf on a scenic tour around the forest, finally ending near a
hidden alcove full of Rupees.

subject: Mido
text: Playing Saria's Song for Mido at the pond makes him let Link pass toward the forest stage.

evidence.quote:
At the stone arch, go right to find yourself at the
Pond.  A still-childlike Mido will block your path to the left.  Play him
Saria's Song, and he'll let you pass.

subject: Forest Stage Cliff
text: In the Forest Stage clearing, riding the Magic Leaf up to the cliff above leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
At the crossroads after Mido, go left to find yourself back in the Forest Stage
clearing.  If you planted the Magic Beans here as a Child, then there will be a
Magic Leaf on the right side of the clearing.  Ride the Magic Leaf up to the
cliff above the clearing, where you will find a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and
take it's token, then return to the previous crossroads.

subject: Lost Woods Path
text: From the entrance to Kokiri Forest, go right, left, right at the stone arch to Mido, left after Mido, left, left again, and right at the next crossroads to reach the Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote:
Go right from the entrance to Kokiri Forest,
and then left on the other side...At the stone arch, go right to find yourself at the
Pond.  A still-childlike Mido will block your path to the left.  Play him
Saria's Song, and he'll let you pass....Go left (straight if you're coming from the Pool), and left again on the other
side.  Take a right at the next crossroads to reach the Sacred Forest Meadow.

subject: Moriblin
text: Moriblins patrol the Sacred Forest Meadow maze and can be defeated by waiting for them to face away and shooting their backs with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Moriblins are huge
goblin-like creatures who patrol the passages in the Sacred Forest Meadow....To defeat the Moriblins, wait
for them to face away from you and shoot them in the back with the Hookshot.

subject: Meadow Maze Ladder
text: At the top of the ladder in the Sacred Forest Meadow maze, go left a short distance to find a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Climb up out of the pool, and climb up the
ladder on the left (if you see a Moriblin here, then wait for him to turn away
before climbing out of the pool).  At the top of the ladder, go to the left a
short ways to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Meadow Maze Pit
text: A pit in the center of the Sacred Forest Meadow maze contains a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote:
In the center of the maze, there is a pit
which contains a handy Fairy Fountain.

subject: Monblin
text: The Monblin at the top of the staircase attacks with shockwaves and is defeated by dodging left and right, getting behind him, and hitting his back with two Jump Attacks.

evidence.quote:
Go up the
stairset opposite the ladder, and at the top you'll see a Monblin.  The Monblin
will attack you by sending shockwaves down the long passage.  Dodge the
shockwaves by running to the left and right between each shockwave, and running
around behind the Monblin when you reach him.  Kill the Monblin by performing
two Jump Attacks against his backside, whereupon he will drop a large number of
Rupees.

subject: Sheik
text: Stepping onto the Triforce pedestal past the Monblin triggers Sheik to appear and teach the Minuet of Forest.

evidence.quote:
Once the Monblin is dead, go up the stairset behind him and step onto the large
pedestal inscribed with the Triforce, where a cutscene will introduce you to
Sheik once more.  Sheik will teach you the Minuet of Forest, which will
transport you to this location every time you play the song.

subject: Shattered Stairset Tree Branch
text: Hookshotting the large tree branch above the shattered staircase leads up to the entrance doorway of the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote:
After Sheik departs, use the Hookshot on the large tree branch which hangs
above the shattered stairset.  Once you're at the top of the stairs, go through
the doorway to enter Adult Link's first dungeon.
